Note: Yearly share of the pool released as CO2 on a Barren cell. Each rate is the pool's whole yearly loss on Barren in lucasWet (Barataria library, 2026-11): its emission plus its decay to the slow pool (0.6516 + 0.1479). Here all of it goes to the atmosphere and none to soil, so the soil stays as it was when the cell became barren (user 2026-11-27)
